name: Veil of Glamour
description: Unseen or misread: harder to hit.

name: Tongues
description: Learns what is said to it, and what is not: +EXP.

name: Sight of the Hidden
description: Finds what is hidden and what is coming: truer aim.

name: Liberal Sciences
description: Arts and sciences taught: learns faster and finds the weak point.

name: Herbs and Stones
description: Cures and mends: at half HP or less, takes less from each blow.

name: Light Fingers
description: Slips what is thrown at it.

name: Concord
description: Kindles love and reconciles foes: a little truer and a little safer.

name: Strife
description: Skilled in arms and battle: hits harder and finds the weak point.

name: Voice of Beasts
description: Understands beasts: against mounted foes, truer and safer.

name: Swift Carrying
description: Carries or is carried anywhere in a moment: faster.

name: Storm and Water
description: Lightning, water and wind: with a bow, truer and sharper.

name: Speaking Dead
description: Moves the dead and speaks with their souls: at half HP or less, strikes harder.

name: Treasure and Coin
description: Finds and turns treasure to gold: a little guarded.
